nights.title: The Guest List
nights.name: The Guest List
nights.extract: The Guest List are an English indie rock band from Manchester, formed in 2021. The band consists of Cai Alty, Tom Quigley, Leio Hunter, Sid Wallace (bass) and Angus Gilchrist (drums). They first gained attention online with covers of indie songs before releasing original material, and released their debut album, Something Real, in August 2026.
